mapper.sql: id, user_id, memory_id, practice_type, target_point_id, status, source_conversation_id, analysis_id, total_attempts, correct_attempts, started_at, completed_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO practice_session (user_id, memory_id, practice_type, target_point_id, status, source_conversation_id, analysis_id, total_attempts, correct_attempts, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memoryId}, #{practiceType}, #{targetPointId}, #{status}, #{sourceConversationId}, #{analysisId}, #{totalAttempts}, #{correctAttempts}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM practice_session WHERE memory_id = #{memoryId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE practice_session SET status = #{status}, analysis_id = #{analysisId}, source_conversation_id = #{sourceConversationId}, total_attempts = #{totalAttempts}, correct_attempts = #{correctAttempts}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM practice_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND analysis_id = #{analysisId}
